name: GitHub
description: Read repositories and code, manage issues and pull requests, and inspect GitHub workflows.

environment.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
environment.description: A GitHub personal access token limited to the repositories and operations the user intends to expose.

notes: Or does not currently support MCP OAuth, so this template uses personal access token authentication.
The tools exposed by the server depend on token permissions and may modify repositories, issues, pull requests, and workflows.
Use a fine-grained token with the minimum repository access and permissions needed.
